c004.coordinator_notes: I rejected all eight native predictions. They concern F_2^n, a different function f_i, graph cost minimization, vertex and edge counts, and weights equal to 1/lambda_1, and none matches the abstract or this construction, so they are not used. Corrections from the previous spec: (1) I verified a valid MAJ3 span program, with v1=(0,1), v2=(1,1), v3=(1,-1) and t=(1,0). (2) I replaced the Trotter product with an exact dense exponential. (3) The root is explicitly the column-0 vertex at index 0, which is documented. (4) The graph is now explicit: the root column is t, the inputs are columns, and the 2 span coordinates are rows. I computed the ideal zero-eigenspace root overlaps by hand: 0 for f=0 and at least 1/3 for f=1. These are hand-derived, not simulated. I have not read the paper, and this reconstruction is a single-gate illustration only, with no complexity claim.
